name: @jeevanand/browserbox-app
description: Run the BrowserBox app (agent, desktop, docs) on localhost, or get its build to host yourself: npx @jeevanand/browserbox-app

scripts.prepack: node -e "const f=require('fs');if(!f.existsSync('../../dist/embed/index.html'))throw new Error('Build the app first: npm run build (in the repository root)');f.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});f.cpSync('../../dist','dist',{recursive:true})"

author: Jeevanand Maurya
